source: Incropera & DeWitt (2006), Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, ch.11; Kays & London (1984), Compact Heat Exchanger Design (3rd ed.)
description: Air-to-liquid finned-tube cross-flow HX discretised into N control volumes. Per-CV energy-balance ODEs for hot (water) stream, cold (air) stream, and tube+fin wall thermal mass. Fin efficiency factored into the air-side UA (the dominant resistance). Steady state reproduces the cross-flow effectiveness-NTU result of the F1a model.

unit.name: Generic finned-tube HX (water-to-air), reuses EC075 F1a geometry

U_overall.note: Overall U on total external area; reused from F1a so SS matches e-NTU. Incropera Table 11.2 air/water finned coils 25-50 W/m2K.

A.note: Total external finned (air-side) area; reused from F1a.

air_side_fraction.note: Fraction of total thermal resistance on the air side (air-side dominant). Kays & London (1984): gas-side resistance dominates compact HX, typ. 0.8-0.9.

fin_efficiency.note: Overall surface (fin) efficiency eta_o for the air-side finned surface. Incropera eq. 11.3, typical aluminium plate-fin coil 0.80-0.90.

cp_hot.note: Liquid water cp at ~40 C, 1 atm. CRC Handbook 97th ed. (2016); Incropera Table A.6.

rho_hot.note: Liquid water density at ~40 C. Incropera Table A.6 (v=1.008e-3 m3/kg).

cp_cold.note: Dry air cp at 300 K, 1 atm. Incropera Table A.4; Kays & London (1984).

rho_cold.note: Dry air density at 300 K, 1 atm. Incropera Table A.4.

cp_wall.note: Aluminium tube+fin material specific heat. Incropera Table A.1 (Al 2024-T6, 300 K).

m_wall.note: Total tube + fin metal mass (thermal mass of the matrix).

V_hot.note: Internal (water) volume of all tubes — sets liquid thermal mass / residence time.

V_cold.note: Air-side free-flow + frontal volume holding the air thermal mass.

N_cv.note: Number of stream-wise control volumes for the lumped discretisation.
